A space-only italic nested inside an otherwise empty strong wrapper still separates the words on either side

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<p><strong>Alpha</strong><strong><i> </i></strong>Beta</p>", options = ConversionOptions$default())
print(result$content)
```
